quests.title: Blooming Sands

dialogue.t: Traveler! Have you brought the stuff?
Huh, so there was another batch after all...
Oh, you mean the stuff he ordered from me? Well, you're in luck! The batch of goods I just received has his stuff in there.
I must say, though, that he ordered quite a lot of things. Are you here to pick up his order?
Well, apart from that pot, he's also ordered various seeds, fertilizer, and other items used in gardening...
They're pretty weighty when put together. Are you sure you'll be fine by yourself?

dialogue.sit: I did agree to help, so...

dialogue.t: Ah, is that so... Well, that's fine. I'll just get all this stuff wrapped up for you. Thanks for making the trip, by the way...
I do hope that Nermin can get better soon...
Strange, where's that other batch of goods?
These are the ones. Thank you so much, Traveler.

dialogue.sit: Sure you're not trying to open your own flower shop?
What do you need so much stuff for!?

dialogue.t: Uh, well, I... I just wanted to buy more at once to save myself some extra trips, you know?
Anyway, go rest over there for a while. I need to sow these seeds and put some fertilizer in and...

dialogue.sit: Raef starts working on the flower pot...

dialogue.t: Alright, this should do it! All Nermin needs to do is water this plant.
Traveler, could I, ah, trouble you to help me bring this flower pot to her?
I need to guard this path. If any foodstuffs or goods pass through, I'll need to get more people from the village to come take them.
And you know how it is around here. If we're too slow, the goods are going to spoil under the sun.
Just do me this favor, please. Nermin's not far from here. All you have to do is give this pot of flowers to her. I'll find a way to bring the rest to her.
I... Did I buy too many things...?
Hello. May I help you with anything?

dialogue.sit: Well, I'm here to give you this flower pot.

dialogue.t: Huh... Is this from Raef?
There are flowers in this pot? Really? Thank you for helping him send this to me. I like it very much...
But... Can I really raise these flowers properly?

dialogue.sit: Is it your first time growing flowers?

dialogue.t: Well, no. I'm just... not very good at taking care of plants. The previous ones all withered in my hands...
I imagine that this pot of flowers must be even more delicate still. If I were to fail to care for it properly again...
Ugh, no, no, I can't just... Since the flowers are already in my hands, I must take good care of it!
Perhaps Granny Kulsoom knows how to solve this problem...
You're back, Traveler. Thank you so much for helping out... How is Nermin doing?

dialogue.sit: She's worried that she won't be able to take care of the flowers.
Have you never sent her flowers before?

dialogue.t: Well... I'll help her look into this. If all else fails, we'll find someone to ask about it.
And if even that fails... I'll just... look for something that's easy to grow and keep alive, I guess.
Well, in any case, thanks for helping me out, Traveler. Please, take this as your reward.
I'll send the other items to her later.
Wait a moment. Did these gardening tools not come with instruction manuals? ...Oh no. I have no idea how to use them!
If these flowers needs to be watered every day, just how much water will I need by the end?

quests.description: Raef from Aaru Village seems to be troubled by something…
